tasks.title: Add --out flag to /investigate with raw and slack modes
tasks.description: Add --out flag parsing to /investigate SKILL.md. Default mode is slack, which routes to answer-composer for voiced output. Accepted values are raw (returns investigation-result JSON directly) and slack. v1 supports only these two modes. The answer-composer agent is retained as the slack voicing layer and called exclusively from /investigate --out slack.
acceptance_criteria: /investigate with no --out flag defaults to slack mode and routes through answer-composer
/investigate --out raw returns investigation-result JSON without voicing
/investigate --out slack routes through answer-composer and returns voiced output
Tests cover both modes and the default
tasks.summary: Added --out flag parsing to /investigate SKILL.md. Step 0 documents the flag (accepted values: raw, slack; default: slack) and strips it from args before investigation. Step 3 branches on the flag: --out raw returns investigation-result JSON directly; --out slack (default) passes the result to answer-composer for a voiced Slack reply. A bash validation script with 10 checks confirms all acceptance criteria are present in SKILL.md.

tasks.title: Add input guard to /investigate (JSON vs prose detection)
tasks.description: Add an input guard to /investigate that detects whether the input is schema-valid investigation-result JSON or raw prose. Schema-valid JSON skips fresh investigation and passes directly to the voicing layer (answer-composer for --out slack, returned directly for --out raw). Raw prose always spawns fresh investigation via the investigator. Invalid JSON that does not match the investigation-result schema is treated as prose and triggers fresh investigation. This guard prevents un-investigated prose from ever reaching the answer-composer.
acceptance_criteria: Raw prose input always triggers fresh investigation
Schema-valid investigation-result JSON input skips investigation and goes to voicing
Invalid JSON (not matching investigation-result schema) is treated as prose and triggers fresh investigation
Tests cover all three input paths: prose, valid investigation-result JSON, invalid JSON
tasks.summary: Added 'Step 1 — Input guard (JSON vs prose detection)' to /investigate SKILL.md. The guard checks whether cleaned input is schema-valid investigation-result JSON (schema_version + verdict + evidence present): if valid, it short-circuits directly to voicing (Step 4) skipping the investigator; if invalid JSON or plain prose it falls through to link detection (Step 2) and the investigator (Step 3). Existing steps renumbered. Six new structural tests added; all 19 investigate skill tests pass.

tasks.title: Update investigator agent for bounded expansion
tasks.description: Update the investigator agent to implement bounded expansion. After answering the literal claim, the investigator identifies a relevance-gated set of adjacent material facts the asker likely needs, investigates each, and includes only those with supporting evidence and a blob-URL citation (using the citation construction from commit 3c31398, unchanged). Facts that prove uninformative are dropped. The specific cap count is left to implementation judgment. This always-on behavior applies to all callers including pr-revise and pr-code-review.
acceptance_criteria: Investigator returns adjacent material facts beyond the literal claim when they are relevant
Each adjacent fact carries a blob-URL citation pointing to the supporting code location
Facts with no supporting evidence are excluded from the investigation-result
investigation-result schema remains valid with the expanded output
Blob-URL citation construction from commit 3c31398 is used without modification
Tests verify a representative claim produces expansion with citations
tasks.summary: Added bounded expansion to the investigator orchestrator: a new Step 4 identifies 2-4 relevance-gated adjacent material facts after resolving the literal claim, investigates each via leaf agents, drops facts with no evidence (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE), and emits survivors with GitHub blob-URL citations in a new optional adjacent_facts field. Schema, contract doc, and agent instructions updated; 17 bash checks and 12 new Python tests verify the behavior.
